property_summary: For any non-empty recipient/value array, C must dispatch exactly one call per element using the canonical ERC20 transferFrom selector, so a recorder that only accepts transferFrom(address,address,uint256) records N well-formed calls and returns success, whereas the mutant uses selector keccak("") and therefore records zero well-formed calls while still reporting success.
change_summary: Replace the keccak256 selector string with an empty string, causing the external calls to use a different function selector.
